test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Nandita was seeking a good research area where she could prepare a good proposal for submission.

options.text: A good research area was sought by Nandita where a good proposal could have prepared by her for submission.
A good research area had been sought by Nandita where a good proposal could have been prepared by her for submission.
A good research area was being sought by Nandita where a good proposal could be prepared by her for submission.
A good research area were sought by Nandita where a good proposal could prepare by her for submission.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A good research area was being sought by Nandita where a good proposal could be prepared by her for submission."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **“Nandita was seeking a good research area where she could prepare a good proposal for submission” **is in the active voice.
 
• In this sentence, **“Nandita” **is the subject, **“was seeking” **is the verb, and **“a good research area” **is the object.
 
• When we convert an active sentence into a passive one, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb is changed to a form of **“be” **followed by the **past participle **of the main verb.
 
• In the case of the sentence **“A good research area was being sought by Nandita where a good proposal could be prepared by her for submission”**, **“a good research area” **is the subject, **“was being sought” **is the verb, and **“Nandita” **is the object.
 
• This is the past continuous passive form.
 
• It implies that the action of seeking a good research area was ongoing at some point in the past.
 
• The second part of the sentence **“where a good proposal could be prepared by her for submission” **remains the same in both active and passive voices because it’s a dependent clause that provides additional information about the research area.
 
• So, the correct answer is **"Option 3". **
